analysis: SFMC-REQ-036 specifies a performance timing requirement for software initialization following hardware power-up. It defines a precise, measurable threshold (30 seconds) triggered by a distinct event ('spacecraft computer power is applied'). It contains no vague degree words, escape clauses, or unassigned responsibilities, adhering directly to guidance for startup timing requirements in SWEHB 5.09 §3.2.2.1.
summary: SFMC-REQ-036 is an acceptable timing requirement that provides a verifiable 30-second threshold for software initialization after power is applied.
